title: Smolensk Under Assault
subtitle: The struggle for the city and Soviet resistance beyond it
author: R.G. Cruise
phase: II — The Drive into the Soviet Interior
summary: Planned study: The German entry into Smolensk, continuing Soviet positions and the northern counterstroke at Soltsy.
outlineTopics: Fighting within and around the city.
The roles of German 2nd and 3rd Panzer Groups.
Soviet formations defending the city and surrounding region.
The distinction between German entry into the city and the continued fighting in surrounding Soviet positions.
Soviet attempts to maintain communications and escape routes.
German difficulties maintaining the momentum of the armored advance.
The Soviet counterattack around Soltsy, beginning July 14.
Soviet resistance against Army Group North and its significance for the approach toward Leningrad.
researchStatus: Editorial outline established; full narrative, document locators and the dated military situation require research.
